starterBundle.name: telegram-starter
starterBundle.summary: Spark agent runtime: model routing, Telegram chat, memory, Researcher, Spark Character, and Spawner/Mission Control for builds

recommendedFlow.goal: Download the installer, review the dry-run plan, then run it locally.
Pick one LLM provider for Agent and Mission unless the user explicitly wants advanced role splits.
Create a BotFather bot and paste secrets only into local Spark setup.
Open the Spark bot in Telegram, send a normal message, then try a tiny /run build.
Tell the user their agent will guide memory, missions, and self-improvement for their specific workflows.

installOptions.label: macOS, Linux, WSL
installOptions.description: Download the site-hosted installer, show the dry-run plan, then ask before installing. The dry-run shows the selected bundle, whether voice is included, and whether autostart will mutate login items.
installOptions.singleCopyBlock:
curl -fsSL https://agent.sparkswarm.ai/install.sh -o spark-install.sh
bash spark-install.sh --dry-run
bash spark-install.sh

installOptions.label: Windows PowerShell
installOptions.description: Download the site-hosted installer, show the dry-run plan, then ask before installing. The dry-run shows the selected bundle, whether voice is included, and whether autostart will mutate login items.
installOptions.singleCopyBlock:
iwr https://agent.sparkswarm.ai/install.ps1 -OutFile spark-install.ps1
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\spark-install.ps1 -DryRun
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\spark-install.ps1

telegramSmokeTest: Open your Spark bot in Telegram.
If Telegram asks for a start code, send /start.
Send a normal message and confirm the LLM responds.
botFatherSetup: Copy the token BotFather gives you.
Message @userinfobot and copy your numeric Telegram id.
Use the BotFather token and numeric id only in local spark setup.
llmProviderExamples: spark setup --chat-llm-provider openai --builder-llm-provider openai --memory-llm-provider ollama --mission-llm-provider openai

telegramCommands.use: Open the basic command surface when Telegram asks for a start step.
Show your numeric Telegram id for admin setup.
Check Telegram, LLM, memory, Spark runtime, and mission relay health.
Save a memory through Spark's memory path when available.
Search your Spark memory when available.
Create a Spawner mission from Telegram.
Run a local Builder chip loop and report from local status files. Spark Swarm Workspace is optional.
List local or connected Workspace recursive loops.
Show a compact recursive loop result from local status or connected Workspace state.
Ask Spark to answer through the configured LLM provider.

moduleRoles.role: Telegram front door. Owns the bot token, runs long polling, and receives chat commands.
Identity and permission runtime. Keeps persona, consent, and self-improvement signals understandable.
Runtime router. Handles identity, memory bridge, provider routing, and domain-chip activation.
Default memory chip. Provides memory contracts, benchmark checks, and memory-oriented skills.
Research and advisory runtime. Helps with research, evidence packets, and domain-chip authoring.
Local mission control. Creates and tracks missions, projects, and execution workflows.

optionalPublicLabs.role: Public creator standards for domain chips, benchmark packs, specialization paths, autoloop policies, tool integrations, and publish packet drafts.
Public modular personality chip experiments connected to Spark character and personality composition.
Public voice communication hooks, voice profiles, and provider examples.

unreleasedBoundaries: Spark Swarm network/workspace submission is not a public installer dependency yet; local Telegram recursive Builder chip loops do not require it.
Optional public labs are builder surfaces until they expose the installable Spark module contract.
securityNotes: Primary install path downloads scripts for inspection before execution.
Installer SHA-256 checksums are published beside the scripts for local verification.
Launch path uses Telegram long polling, not webhooks.
LLM provider keys and Telegram bot tokens are configured locally by the user.
Installer scripts are hosted on agent.sparkswarm.ai and lock Spark CLI source overrides behind an explicit developer flag.
Installer manages Python 3.11 with a pinned uv binary when a compatible local Python is not already available.
Spark CLI installs from an immutable commit SHA by default.
The default telegram-starter bundle does not require voice; use telegram-voice-starter when speech I/O is desired.
Unattended --yes/non-interactive installer runs default to --no-autostart unless --autostart is passed explicitly.
Windows upgrades remove stale Spark-owned spark.exe shims so the new spark.cmd wrapper wins on PATH.

upgradeExisting.summary: Use this only when Spark is already installed and the user wants to update the existing Spark CLI in place.
upgradeExisting.safety: Run the dry-run first. Upgrade mode writes to the existing Spark prefix; unattended --yes/non-interactive runs do not enable autostart unless --autostart is passed explicitly.
